get_trainer_kitti: get the KITTI AR training framework class by passing 'KITTI_AR' to get_trainer
get_trainer_sintel: get the Sintel AR training framework class by passing 'SINTEL_AR' to get_trainer
create_trainframework_kitti: create a KITTI AR TrainFramework instance with data loaders, model, and config
create_trainframework_sintel: create a Sintel AR TrainFramework instance with data loaders, model, and config
run_training_epoch: run one training epoch with the TrainFramework using timing and loss meters
